content.comment_body: I successfully installed the [product_name] program on my computer, but when I try to launch it, only an empty window appears. It seems there may be an issue with Java, as the program runs but lacks the graphical interface. System: Linux Ubuntu 7.10 Java installed: JDK 6.0 Installation path: /home/programs/logo I also tried installing it to the default path (/usr/local/bin/[company_name]/...) but the problem persists. Does anyone know what I can do to fix this? Thanks
Hello, which JRE version are you using? regards [user_name]
Hi, I have Java 6 JRE. As mentioned, when I open the program it runs without the graphical interface—perhaps it doesn't recognize where the Java JRE is located? Thank you

Sorry, I wasn't sure if JDK already includes the JRE. In this case, I think the JRE might not be registered in the environment variable. Are you familiar with adjusting this in Linux? On Windows, you would go to: Start > Settings > Control Panel > System > Advanced > Environment Variables > PATH. Does this help?

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered a significant problem when running [product_name] on Linux Ubuntu 7.10. After installation, the application only displayed a blank window without the graphical interface. The issue appears connected to incorrect or unrecognized Java environment configuration, particularly regarding the JRE path.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] to launch with a working graphical interface post-installation, with the required Java settings automatically detected or easy to set up.
